rows: the first declaration of each game (game3 203, game4 238), the earlier less 10 turns for the build-up and the march
the second-lowest power ratio (M lines, the turn before) of the 10 declarations, rounded down to tens: all but one were at least this
the shortest time from a peace to the next declaration of the same game (5 gaps)

the fewest units the human moved (MISSION_MOVE_TO commands, A lines, by group size) on a turn it declared (10 turns: 5, 6, 7, 8, 8, 10, 12, 16, 18, 26); the seat declares once this many of its fighting land units stand within two plots of the target's cities

the lower of the games' 10th percentiles of the odds (per mille) of the human's attacks (C lines; game3: 726 of 14 attacks, game4: 716 of 80 attacks), rounded down to tens; the seat attacks whenever its odds reach this
not in the data (every human preparation ended in a declaration): a preparation is given up after this
one war of its own at a time: the human's rule until its last 15 turns in game 4
no limit: the nearest team qualifying is chosen whatever its distance
the median, rounded up, of turns from the last capture to peace over the 7 ended wars with a capture
the longest of the 7 ended wars (declaration to peace)
the first sale of a tech for gold (9 sales: D items, tech given, gold received, no peace treaty)
the mean of the 7 gaps between sales of the same game, rounded
the smallest gold received for a tech
one choice in this many is the AI's: the human's completions (350 buildings, N lines; 174 units, U lines) over its unit completions, rounded
as ai_every: no rule from the data for a different share in war
not measured: a city builds a settler only from this size
